ache.title: ‘Start now!’ An anniversary rush, gift-wrapped
ache.note: Start Aether Gazer now, says this anniversary video: best characters for each element, special giveaways, how to pull guaranteed characters. Anniversaries are when games hand out gifts to hook new players into a habit, and ‘Now’ in the title is the urgency talking. A good game is still good after the party ends.
ache.tip: Tempted to start a gacha for its anniversary? Wait until it ends. If you still want it, start calmly.
lines: NOW! says the anniversary. later, says me
free gifts are how the hook gets baited

textData.text: In this video, I'll guide you through starting Aether Gazer, a fantastic game by Yongshi and Yostar, creators of Arknights. Discover the best characters and team compositions for each element, including fire, ice, thunder, wind, light, water, and shadow. Learn about special giveaways, how to pull guaranteed characters, and optimize your gameplay. If you have any questions, drop a comment below. Enjoy and happy gaming!
